label: copy-phase fed-back f (late steps, or followed by f/0)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost always (98% of mass) when the fed-back input token is f (a few weak activations on input 0). Magnitude grows with absolute step t (peaks t=15-17, i.e. long L=8-9 sequences, late recall positions) and is highest when the next token to output is f or 0 (top examples: f f, f 0). Never fires in the original or delimiter phases or on any other letter. Precision is low (~18%): most copy-phase f inputs, especially early ones in short sequences with other successors, stay silent, so the predicate captures where it fires but not reliably when.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: f, 0, -, o, q, d; least: n, j, t, <DEL>) and the token being output (most: f, 0, h, 1, z, b; least: -, 3, v, k); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=7, t=15, t=16.
